name: Natalia Cellmer

Łazińsk, Landgemeinde Drommin, Landkreis Konin, Regierungsbezirk Hohensalza, Reichsgau Wartheland, Nazi Germany

citations.text:
Note that this death reference is misattributed to the wrong Natalia Cellmer - the one here is I3348!
See C0928 which shows that I3285 was married to Henryk Ferl (I3391) and became Natalia Ferl after marriage.

notes:
A death record exists for Natalia Cellmer (C0898) which states that she died at 3 weeks old in 1890, yet a marriage record also exists for her and Henryk Ferl (I3391) from 1914 (C0928). It is unknown where the error is; perhaps the priest recorded the wrong person dying in 1890, or someone else assumed Natalia Cellmer's identity.

Locate the death record (Drommin/Trąbczyn civil records No. 52, 1944) for Natalia to confirm that she is the correct person listed in the marriage record from C0928. C0957 is a separate reference to her death, misattributed to the incorrect person, but not the actual death record. As of 05/2024, civil records for 1944 have not been publicly released.
